title: Forest structure API lemmas: simp membership and field forwarders
intent: Wrap the Forest n structure's raw projections and predicate fields in a block of @[simp] membership lemmas and one-line forwarding lemmas, so that every later client reads and reasons about a forest through the coercions u ∈ t and t u without unfolding Forest.mk or the projections 𝔘 / 𝔗.

parent.name: Forest-API-lemmas
parent.statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_mk (n 𝔘 𝔗 a b c d e f g h) (p : 𝔓 X) :
    p ∈ Forest.mk (n := n) 𝔘 𝔗 a b c d e f g h ↔ p ∈ 𝔘 := Iff.rfl

@[simp] lemma mem_𝔘 : u ∈ t.𝔘 ↔ u ∈ t := .rfl
@[simp] lemma mem_𝔗 : p ∈ t.𝔗 u ↔ p ∈ t u := .rfl

lemma nonempty (hu : u ∈ t) : (t u).Nonempty := t.nonempty' hu
lemma ordConnected (hu : u ∈ t) : OrdConnected (t u) := t.ordConnected' hu
lemma 𝓘_ne_𝓘 (hu : u ∈ t) (hp : p ∈ t u) : 𝓘 p ≠ 𝓘 u := t.𝓘_ne_𝓘' hu hp
lemma smul_four_le (hu : u ∈ t) (hp : p ∈ t u) : smul 4 p ≤ smul 1 u := t.smul_four_le' hu hp
lemma stackSize_le : stackSize t x ≤ 2 ^ n := t.stackSize_le'
lemma dens₁_𝔗_le (hu : u ∈ t) : dens₁ (t u) ≤ 2 ^ (4 * (a : ℝ) - n + 1) := t.dens₁_𝔗_le' hu
lemma lt_dist (hu : u ∈ t) (hu' : u' ∈ t) (huu' : u ≠ u') {p} (hp : p ∈ t u') (h : 𝓘 p ≤ 𝓘 u) :
    2 ^ (Z * (n + 1)) < dist_(p) (𝒬 p) (𝒬 u) := t.lt_dist' hu hu' huu' hp h
lemma ball_subset (hu : u ∈ t) (hp : p ∈ t u) : ball (𝔠 p) (8 * D ^ 𝔰 p) ⊆ 𝓘 u :=
  t.ball_subset' hu hp

applicability.goal_shape: A structure Forest n bundling a set 𝔘, a map 𝔗 and eight predicate fields, each field stated over the raw projections with hypotheses hu : u ∈ 𝔘 / hp : p ∈ 𝔗 u; the interface lemmas restate membership and each field over the coercions u ∈ t / t u that CoeHead / Membership / CoeFun declare.
applicability.use_when: many client lemmas access the structure's fields or membership and would otherwise each unfold Forest.mk or the projections; the structure carries (or you add) coercions so that u ∈ t and t u are the natural spellings.
applicability.avoid_when: the structure is used in only one place; clients genuinely need the projection form (e.g. to reason about 𝔘 as a set independent of the forest); or the coercion instances are not in scope, in which case the @[simp] lemmas do not fire.

claims.claim: Each of the eight forwarding lemmas (lines 49-58) is closed by a single application of the corresponding Forest field (nonempty by t.nonempty' hu, … ball_subset by t.ball_subset' hu hp), and the three @[simp] lemmas (lines 43-47) close by Iff.rfl / .rfl; the file is built by the project's CI.
claims.evidence: https://github.com/fpvandoorn/carleson/blob/d75f54374f7f930e70a86b443f20d0e0935c275e/Carleson/Forest.lean#L43-L58; .github/workflows/push.yml runs lean-action with build: true and build-args 'Carleson Challenge Solution' on push to master, which builds Carleson/Forest.lean

claims.claim: The eight forwarding lemmas (lines 49-58) correspond one-to-one to the eight predicate fields of Forest (lines 25-33), each restating one field with hu : u ∈ t / hp : p ∈ t u in place of hu : u ∈ 𝔘 / hp : p ∈ 𝔗 u.
The same interface pattern recurs for the Row structure in the same file (lines 86-101): Row extends Forest, re-declares @[simp] mem_𝔘 / mem_𝔗, and forwards pairwiseDisjoint' to pairwiseDisjoint.
The authors annotate the 𝔗 field with the doc comment "The value of `𝔗 u` only matters when `u ∈ 𝔘`." (line 23), which is exactly the hypothesis the forwarding lemmas lift to the coercion form u ∈ t.
A client in the same file consumes the interface: ball_subset_of_mem_𝓘 (lines 62-65) applies t.ball_subset hu hp (line 64) rather than unfolding the ball_subset' field.

metrics.how_counted: parent_lines = lines 43-58 of the copied file; children = the 11 lemmas in that block (3 @[simp] membership lemmas + 8 field forwarders); fields_forwarded = the 8 predicate fields of Forest at lines 25-33

consequences: The interface adds 11 lemmas at near-zero proof cost (each a one-line forward), but they must stay in sync if a field's statement changes. It re-binds the hypotheses from the projection form (u ∈ 𝔘, p ∈ 𝔗 u) to the coercion form (u ∈ t, p ∈ t u), so a client that still holds u ∈ 𝔘 must first rewrite via mem_𝔘 before applying a forwarder. The @[simp] lemmas make the projection/coercion translation automatic, but they only fire once the CoeHead / Membership / CoeFun instances are in scope; outside that scope the forwarders still work but the spelling does not normalise.
